title: Elena's plan
toneLine: You don't have to do it all this week. Pick the paint colour today and let the rest wait.

areas.name: Home
areas.goal: Living room painted and guest room ready before Giulia arrives on 6 November
areas.why: First visit in three years; I want the flat to feel like mine

areas.name: Money
areas.goal: Stop paying for things I don't use, and get the paperwork done
areas.why: Feels like money leaks every month

areas.name: Health
areas.goal: Keep the routines that make me feel good

steps.title: Get two quotes from painters
steps.notes: Marco was cheaper and can come sooner

steps.title: Choose the colour for the living room
steps.notes: Between warm white and the pale green sample. Marco needs it a week before he starts.

steps.title: Marco confirms the painting dates
steps.notes: He said probably 26 to 28 October. Call him on Wednesday if he hasn't confirmed.

steps.title: Living room painted
steps.notes: Move the bookshelf the weekend before

steps.title: Clear out and clean the guest room
steps.notes: Could ask Luca to carry the boxes to the cellar

steps.title: Review subscriptions and cancel what I don't use
steps.notes: See the Subscriptions list. The gym renews on 1 November.

steps.title: Sign the will
steps.notes: The lawyer sent the final draft; it needs an appointment to sign it in her office. No deadline.

steps.title: Move savings to the higher-interest account
steps.notes: The bank app keeps rejecting the ID photo. Try at the branch.
